correctness.rationale: Exact factorization on every one of 2^s input residue classes yields a scaled dyadic isometry: 2^{s-v2(a+1)}Z_2 for a<r, and 1+2Z_2 for a=r. Each scale j has exactly 2^{j-1} branches. This proves period upper bound, sharp period lower bound, all residue multiplicities and Haar distribution. Full quantifiers s,k>=1 include the Lucas parity boundary. A standalone checker tests finite cases from actual embedded bytes, not as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full Lane 2023 and Barat-Grabner 2001 texts were inspected, including the latter’s introduction and all-coefficient Theorem 7. Neither gives exact one-column Mersenne-index fibers. The public third-column finding is the covered s=2 subcase, but does not imply the new uniform hierarchy for all s>=3. Distinct fifth-column data do not dominate the family. Relevant searches found no general equivalent, though priority risk is nonzero.
residual_risks: The indexed third-column result is a known included special case. Its full text was inaccessible, so equivalences implied by unshown general propositions cannot be fully excluded.
Potential unindexed earlier fixed-column 2-adic distribution results could anticipate this hierarchy; negative search alone cannot prove novelty.

value.rationale: Exact classification of every residue multiplicity and exact least period at every 2-power, simultaneously for the natural infinite family of Mersenne lower indices. Reveals an unbounded staircase of geometrically growing dyadic output densities, extending beyond the known isolated lower-index 3 case and contrasting with whole-row uniformity.
